bits.description: If true, calculates bits instead of bytes

pad.description: If true, pads decimal places to match round parameter

base.description: Number base (2 for binary, 10 for decimal, -1 for auto)

round.description: Number of decimal places to round to

locale.description: Locale for number formatting, true for system locale

spacer.description: String to separate value and unit

standard.description: Unit standard to use (SI, IEC, JEDEC)

fullform.description: If true, uses full unit names instead of abbreviations

precision.description: Number of significant digits (0 for auto)

FilesizeOptions.description: Options interface for configuring filesize behavior
